method: Development-only purposive sample: lower and upper score thirds in each of tank/damage-support/other × win/loss. Includes both saved profiles; one performance per match. Known inspected Skarner match excluded. This selection is score-stratified, not random population validation, and reviewer may recognize prior games. Do not use for estimating population accuracy. Freeze reviews before opening this key. Timeline cache is not proof a replay or usable timeline exists.
